sloka: श्रुत्वा तु अहम् अयोध्यायाम् विवाह अर्थम् तव आत्मजान् ।मिथिलाम् उपयातान् तु त्वया सह महीपते ॥१-७३-५॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu aham ayodhyāyām vivāha artham tava ātmajān ।mithilām upayātān tu tvayā saha mahīpate ॥1-73-5॥

translations.english: O King having heard in Ayodhya that you have arrived in Mithila along with your sons for their marriage I came here speedily with a desire to see my sister's son .
